name: Pros and cons
oneLiner: two glass cards stand up off a lit floor, a green check badge over the pros and a red cross over the cons; rows land alternately with each mark drawn and the counts ticking, then the winning card steps forward in its colour while the other falls back
say: when the speaker weighs something up ('the good: it saves hours... the catch: a day to set up'): one row per point as it is said, the winning side steps forward on the verdict ('still worth it'). winner auto picks the longer list; set none for a neutral list
